<?php

$strings = [
    '(a + b) * [c - d]', '{x = [1, 2, (3 + 4)]}', 'f(a[i] + g(b)}', '(1 + 2)) * 3',
    'if (a < b) { c = d[0]; }', '((a + b] * c', '[{(x * y) - z}',
];
$matching = [')' => '(', ']' => '[', '}' => '{'];
foreach ($strings as $text) {
    $stack = [];
    $error = -1;
    for ($position = 0; $position < strlen($text); $position++) {
        $c = $text[$position];
        if (str_contains('([{', $c)) {
            $stack[] = $c;
        } elseif (isset($matching[$c])) {
            if (!$stack || $stack[count($stack) - 1] !== $matching[$c]) {
                $error = $position;
                break;
            }
            array_pop($stack);
        }
    }
    if ($error < 0 && $stack) {
        $error = strlen($text);
    }
    printf("%s -> %s\n", $text, $error < 0 ? 'balanced' : 'error at index ' . $error);
}
